lock.settingsBody: When enabled, MailDaan asks for this password after every start before the archive becomes accessible. This is an application access lock only — it does not encrypt the email archive.
lock.locked: The application is locked. Please unlock it first.
lock.tooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters.
lock.notEnabled: Application password protection is not enabled.
lock.alreadyEnabled: Application password protection is already enabled.
lock.hint: The enforced minimum is 8 characters, but at least 12 is recommended. Use a long, unpredictable passphrase. Avoid common passwords, repeated sequences, predictable patterns, and anything related to your email address or the application name. Specific character categories (digits, symbols) are not required — length and unpredictability matter more.
lock.lockedBody: Enter the application password to access the archive.

tls.pinMismatch: The certificate presented by the server no longer matches the certificate you previously trusted for this account. The connection was refused to protect your credentials.
tls.subject: Subject
tls.trustHint: Trusting remembers this certificate for this account only. MailDaan refuses to connect when the certificate changes.
tls.caFailed: The selected file is not a usable PEM certificate authority.
tls.changed: The certificate changed while you were deciding. Please review the certificate and try again.

sync.title: Synchronization
sync.idleBody: Synchronization downloads every message from all IMAP folders into the local archive. When interrupted, it resumes from the last checkpoint.
sync.cancelConfirm: Cancel synchronization? Downloaded messages will be kept and the next sync will resume.
sync.cancelling: Cancelling the synchronization… You will switch accounts when it is safe.
sync.switchBlockedBody: A synchronization is running for {account}. Switching now is unsafe.
sync.syncActiveExit: Synchronization is still running. Exit anyway? Progress will be saved and the next sync resumes from the checkpoint.
sync.attachModeWithDesc: Every message is downloaded together with its attachment files.
sync.attachModeWithoutDesc: Only message text is downloaded; attachments can be fetched later.
sync.attachModeHint: When you start the synchronization, you choose whether attachments are downloaded.
sync.authFailed: The IMAP server rejected the login. Check the email address and password for this account.
sync.dnsFailed: The IMAP server address could not be found. Check the IMAP server name in the account settings.
sync.connectFailed: Could not connect to the IMAP server.
sync.timeout: The connection to the IMAP server timed out.
sync.refused: The IMAP server refused the connection.
sync.tlsError: A secure connection to the IMAP server could not be established.
sync.failed: Synchronization failed before it could finish.
